profile.headline: Co-Founder & CFO, The Nest Montessori Network | Army Veteran | Systems, Finance & Operations Behind Schools That Last | Founder: Classroom Comeback, Nest Paint
profile.summary:
I build the systems underneath schools.
 
I'm the Co-Founder and CFO of The Nest, a nationally accredited network of Montessori schools serving children from infancy through adolescence. My job is everything families never see: finance, operations, compliance architecture, and the culture that lets guides do their best work in the classroom.
 
My path here was not a straight line. Ten years in the U.S. Army as a logistics sergeant taught me what systems can do: I rewrote standard operating procedures and inventory processes that recovered over $2,000,000 in missing property, and I learned that precision and integrity are what actually hold organizations together. A Master of Science in Clinical Social Work took me into trauma shelters, addiction counseling, and hospice rooms, where I learned what human beings need most in seasons of uncertainty. Degrees in psychology and computer science round out the toolkit: I understand people, and I can build the software.
 
All of it converges at The Nest. Alongside our schools, I co-founded Classroom Comeback (learning space redesign consulting) and Nest Paint (children's books and coloring books), and I'm building Perch, a Montessori learning record app for guides and families.
 
I write here about the real numbers, systems, and operational architecture behind education that lasts- the parts of school-building nobody puts in the brochure.
 
Speaking and media: hello@ericacharris.com | ericacharris.com

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description: Consulting practice redesigning learning environments for schools and educators. We turn tired classrooms into prepared environments: space planning, furnishings strategy, and the operational thinking behind rooms that work for children and the adults who teach them.

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description: Children's coloring book brand and publishing venture encouraging creative expression. Growing into the publishing arm for original children's titles.

positions.title: Co-Founder & Chief Financial Officer
positions.description:
I co-founded The Nest in April 2022 and opened our first campus in Austin that November. Today we are a nationally accredited network of Montessori schools serving children from infancy through adolescence across multiple campuses, with another in development on 50 acres of working ranch land in the Texas Hill Country.
 
As CFO, I own everything underneath the classrooms: finance, operations, HR, legal compliance, and vendor and enrollment strategy. My job is building the architecture that lets our guides focus on children instead of chaos.
 
What that has looked like in practice:
 
- Built the network's financial systems from the ground up, including cost-of-care modeling, debt restructuring, and the capital strategy behind our growth
- Authored a library of more than 200 standard operating procedures across 17 operational domains, from classroom safety to payroll to licensing compliance
- Led the compliance infrastructure supporting Texas state licensing, Texas Rising Star certification, and Cognia accreditation, earned within four years of opening
- Negotiated leases, loans, and partnerships that turned a single campus into a growing network
- Own HR end-to-end: hiring architecture, compensation frameworks, and the hard conversations
 
Alongside the schools, our network includes Nest Paint, a children's publishing brand, and a planned nonprofit arm for tuition assistance.
 
We reached 137 enrollments within six months of opening our first campus.

positions.title: Software Engineer Consultant
positions.description: Enterprise DevOps consulting: Java, SQL, Unix, CI/CD pipelines, and secure development practices, following FDM's intensive engineering training program. My last stop in software before founding The Nest — the technical foundation I now use to build tools for our schools.
positions.insights: Skills: Web Development · Data Access · Java · Oracle SQL Developer

positions.title: Assistant Director
positions.description:
Where school operations became my craft. Owned the admissions pipeline and family relationships from first inquiry to enrollment, and maintained student records under Texas licensing requirements.
 
Gave 60+ school tours in three months with a 70% enrollment conversion rate
Grew enrollment month over month with strong retention
Built enrollment and withdrawal process training materials adopted across multiple campuses as a model workflow
 
A year inside a national Montessori operator showed me both what excellent operations look like and what I would build differently. Eight months after leaving, we founded The Nest.
positions.insights: Skills: Process Improvement · Customer Relationship Management (CRM) · Operations Management · Regulatory Compliance

positions.title: Product Director
positions.description:
Ran product end-to-end for an e-commerce business: sourcing, quality systems, brand, and growth.
 
Negotiated exclusive partnerships with four suppliers in China to align the product roadmap
Built quality control that cut defect rates from 35% to under 1%
Led a full website redesign, lifting conversion 28%
Managed inventory pipeline and material pricing, exceeding ROI targets by 150%
positions.insights: Skills: Process Improvement · New Business Development · Product Design · Content Strategy · Customer Experience

positions.title: Clinical Social Work - Children and Families
positions.description: Direct practice across trauma shelters, drug and alcohol counseling, and hospice care, much of it alongside active Army service, while completing a Master of Science in Clinical Social Work specializing in children and families. Those years taught me what safe, responsive environments mean to people in their hardest seasons- the conviction The Nest is built on.

positions.title: Operations and Logistics Sergeant
positions.description:
Initiated conversion to a web-based automated logistics system by rewriting the Standard Operating Procedures and bringing property management programs into compliance. Managed a team of 10 personnel to ensure the success of re-organizational projects to bring records into compliance with Army Standards.

-Managed over 800 lines of Authorized Stockage Listing and $4 million worth of aircraft repair parts with zero loss
-Recovered over $200K in property by briefing superiors on the importance of CSDP compliance and requesting operations stand-down to commission assistance from unit personnel
-Brought property accountability compliance from failing to 96% pass on brigade-level inspection by training and briefing subordinates, peers, and superiors

The decade that taught me what I still believe: organizations run on systems, and systems run on accountability. I've been writing SOPs ever since — The Nest operates on a library of more than 200 of them.
positions.insights: Skills: Operations Management · Compliance Management · Logistics Management
